raw_segments.text: The state of Kentucky was founded in 1775, the state of Ohio only 12 years later.
But 12 years are more in America than half a century in Europe.
And at the present day, the population of Ohio exceeds that of Kentucky by 250,000 souls.
J.D.'s opposite consequences of slavery and freedom may readily be understood,
and they suffice to explain many of the differences which we remark
between the civilization of antiquity and that of our own time.
